highlight-limited-support.description: Highlight is optional, unsaved practice with visible text. Edit its source and print through the browser. Native PDF and block narration are unavailable.

self-check-model-length.description: The model answer exceeds 200 words. Review whether a shorter example would make comparison easier.

self-check-hint-actionable.title: Hint needs a next step
self-check-hint-actionable.description: A hint repeats the criterion or only asks the learner to try again. Explain what to add or change.

self-check-evidence-overlap.title: Overlapping model evidence
self-check-evidence-overlap.description: Overlapping evidence leaves a criterion without its own model mark. Review the evidence excerpts.

completion-gate-reason.title: Missing reason for a blocked next step
completion-gate-reason.description: Learners cannot tell what to do before continuing. Add a reason to this forward-progress gate.

guidance.topic: Explain how to continue
guidance.bullet1: State the action learners must complete before continuing.
guidance.bullet2: Use then: disableCompletion because "Complete the safety check before continuing."

image-alt.title: Missing alt text
image-alt.description: Describe the image's purpose in context, or mark it decorative if it adds no information.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Writing good alt text
guidance.bullet1: Describe what the image communicates in context, not just what it looks like.
guidance.bullet2: Keep alt text under 125 characters whenever possible.
guidance.bullet3: Start with the most important detail first so learners hear the key point immediately.
guidance.bullet4: Skip phrases like "image of" because screen readers already announce images.
guidance.bullet5: If the image is decorative only, mark it as decorative instead of writing alt text.

image-alt-quality.title: Unhelpful alt text
image-alt-quality.description: Replace vague alt text with a clear description of what this image communicates in context.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Writing good alt text

guidance.bullet3: Start with the most important detail first so learners hear the key point immediately.
guidance.bullet4: Skip phrases like "image of" because screen readers already announce images.
guidance.bullet5: If the image is decorative only, mark it as decorative instead of writing alt text.

image-alt-length.title: Long alt text
image-alt-length.description: Keep alt text under 125 characters. Put longer explanations in nearby text or a long description.

gif-flash-threshold.title: Potential rapid flashing
gif-flash-threshold.description: This animated GIF appears to flash more than three times in one second. Replace it or slow the animation, then review it manually.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Reducing flashing risk
guidance.bullet1: Replace the GIF with a still image when motion is not essential.
guidance.bullet2: Otherwise, reduce the animation to three flashes or fewer in any one-second period.
guidance.bullet3: Review the final asset manually because automated flash detection is only an estimate.

images-of-text.title: Image may contain text
images-of-text.description: Replace the image with editable text when possible; real text can be resized, searched, and translated.

media-transcript.title: Missing transcript
media-transcript.description: Add a complete text transcript of the spoken words and meaningful sounds.

video-captions.title: Video missing captions
video-captions.description: Add synchronized captions so learners who are deaf or in noisy environments can follow along.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Adding captions
guidance.bullet1: Upload an SRT or VTT caption file in the video settings and review it for accuracy.
guidance.bullet2: Include speaker labels when multiple people talk, such as "[Instructor]".
guidance.bullet3: Describe meaningful sounds in brackets, such as "[applause]" or "[phone rings]".
guidance.bullet4: Keep captions synchronized with speech so learners can follow without delay.

video-audio-autoplay.title: Media autoplays
video-audio-autoplay.description: Turn off autoplay so learners control when audio or video starts.

media-audio-description.title: No audio description track
media-audio-description.description: Add an audio-description track when important visual information is not explained in the soundtrack.

audio-transcript-quality.title: Placeholder transcript
audio-transcript-quality.description: Replace the placeholder with a complete transcript of the audio.

hotgraphic-alt.title: Hotgraphic missing alt text
hotgraphic-alt.description: Describe the background image. Give learners context before they explore the markers.

hotspot-region-labels.title: Unlabeled hotspot regions
hotspot-region-labels.description: Give every hotspot region a unique label that identifies what learners will open.

hotspot-item-count.title: Too many hotspot regions
hotspot-item-count.description: Use no more than 12 hotspot regions, or divide them across multiple graphics.

auto-advance-pause-control.title: Auto-advance without pause
auto-advance-pause-control.description: Add a pause control or turn off auto-advance so learners can move at their own pace.

page-title.title: Missing page title
page-title.description: Add a short, descriptive page title so learners can identify it in navigation.

lesson-title.title: Lesson has no title
lesson-title.description: Add title: to the lesson frontmatter.

heading-hierarchy.title: Heading level skipped
heading-hierarchy.description: Use heading levels in order so screen reader users can navigate the page structure.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Heading levels
guidance.bullet1: Use headings like an outline: H2 for major sections, H3 for subsections.
guidance.bullet2: Avoid skipping levels because screen reader users navigate by heading structure.
guidance.bullet3: If a page has one section, a single H2 is usually enough.

heading-h1-in-content.title: H1 used in content
heading-h1-in-content.description: Reserve H1 for the page title. Change this content heading to H2 or lower.

heading-length.title: Long heading
heading-length.description: Shorten the heading to 120 characters or fewer so learners can scan it quickly.

duplicate-heading.title: Duplicate heading
duplicate-heading.description: Rename this heading so it identifies its section when read outside the page context.

consecutive-headings.title: Consecutive headings
consecutive-headings.description: Add body content between these headings, or combine them if they describe the same section.

empty-page.title: Empty page
empty-page.description: Add meaningful content to this page, or remove the page if it is not needed.

video-following-heading.title: Media without preceding heading
video-following-heading.description: Add a descriptive heading before this media so learners know what it covers.

empty-link.title: Empty link
empty-link.description: Add meaningful link text so learners know where this link goes before activating it.

link-text-quality.title: Generic link text
link-text-quality.description: Replace generic link text with wording that describes the destination or action.

embed-title.title: Embed missing title
embed-title.description: Add a title that identifies the embedded content or task.

abbreviation-undefined.title: Undefined abbreviation
abbreviation-undefined.description: Define “{abbreviation}” on first use with a tooltip. Its definition will also appear in the course glossary.

duplicate-links.title: Duplicate links
duplicate-links.description: Remove or consolidate links that lead to the same destination.

branch-generic-labels.title: Generic branch option labels
branch-generic-labels.description: Replace labels such as “Option A” with wording that explains each choice.

branch-dead-end.title: Branch dead-end option
branch-dead-end.description: Connect every branch option to a valid destination so learners cannot get stuck.

mcq-question.title: Missing question text
mcq-question.description: Add a clear question that tells learners what to choose.

mcq-correct-answer.title: No correct answer
mcq-correct-answer.description: Mark at least one answer as correct so the quiz can be scored.

gmcq-question.title: Missing question text
gmcq-question.description: Add a clear question that tells learners which image to choose.

gmcq-correct-answer.title: No correct answer
gmcq-correct-answer.description: Mark at least one image option as correct so the quiz can be scored.

slider-question.title: Missing question text
slider-question.description: Add a prompt that tells learners which value to select.

textInput-question.title: Missing question text
textInput-question.description: Add a prompt that tells learners what to enter.

textInput-correct-answer.title: No correct answer
textInput-correct-answer.description: Add at least one accepted answer so the response can be scored.

assessment-format-hint.title: Missing format hint
assessment-format-hint.description: Add a hint or placeholder that shows the expected answer format.

assessment-pass-mark.title: Pass mark is 0%
assessment-pass-mark.description: Set a meaningful pass mark, or confirm that every submitted attempt should pass.

sorting-categories.title: Too few sorting categories
sorting-categories.description: Add at least two categories so learners have a meaningful sorting task.

card-both-sides.title: Card incomplete
card-both-sides.description: Add content to both sides of every card, or remove the incomplete card.

rate-question.title: Rating missing prompt
rate-question.description: Add a prompt that identifies what learners should rate.

assessment-empty-stem.title: Empty question stem
assessment-empty-stem.description: Add a clear question or instruction before the answer options.

assessment-no-correct.title: No correct answer marked
assessment-no-correct.description: Mark at least one option as correct so the assessment can be scored.

assessment-too-few-pairs.title: Too few matching pairs
assessment-too-few-pairs.description: Add at least two pairs so learners have a meaningful matching task.

assessment-too-few-items.title: Too few ordering items
assessment-too-few-items.description: Add at least two items so learners have a meaningful ordering task.

fill-blank-missing-blanks.title: Fill-blank has no blanks
fill-blank-missing-blanks.description: Add at least one blank for learners to complete.

fill-blank-missing-instructions.title: Fill-blank missing instructions
fill-blank-missing-instructions.description: Add instructions that explain how learners should complete the blanks.

fill-blank-open-scored.title: Open blanks cannot be scored
fill-blank-open-scored.description: Replace at least one open blank with a known-answer blank, or turn off scoring. Open blanks have no correct answer.

choice-option-count.title: Too many choice options
choice-option-count.description: Use no more than 10 options, or split the question into smaller tasks.

image-only-options.title: Image-only options
image-only-options.description: Add a text label to each image option. Make each answer clear without the image.

match-pair-count.title: Too many matching pairs
match-pair-count.description: Use no more than eight pairs, or divide them across multiple matching tasks.

drag-variant-keyboard-alt.title: Drag without keyboard alternative
drag-variant-keyboard-alt.description: Provide a keyboard alternative, such as dropdown choices or move up and down buttons.

rating-scale-endpoints.title: Missing scale endpoint labels
rating-scale-endpoints.description: Label the lowest and highest values so learners understand what the rating scale means.

table-headers.title: No table headers
table-headers.description: Enable a header row or column so screen readers can identify each data cell.

table-caption.title: Missing table caption
table-caption.description: Add a short caption that explains what this table represents.

empty-table-cells.title: Empty table cells
empty-table-cells.description: Fill every header cell. If most data cells are empty, use ordinary content instead of a table.

decorative-image-overuse.title: Too many decorative images
decorative-image-overuse.description: Review the decorative images and add alt text to any image that conveys information.

sentence-length-excessive.title: Long sentences
sentence-length-excessive.description: Split long sentences so each sentence communicates one main idea.

paragraph-length-excessive.title: Long paragraphs
paragraph-length-excessive.description: Break this paragraph into shorter sections, each focused on one idea.

image-cluster-without-context.title: Image cluster without text
image-cluster-without-context.description: Add a caption or short note between images. Explain how the images relate.

color-only-information.title: Color-only information
color-only-information.description: Enable the note icon so its meaning is conveyed by more than color.

sensory-only-instructions.title: Sensory-only instructions
sensory-only-instructions.description: Name the control or content instead of referring only to its color, shape, or position.

container-single-item.title: Single-item container
container-single-item.description: Remove the container and show its only item directly.

container-too-many-items.title: Too many container items
container-too-many-items.description: Use no more than six tabs, or divide the content into smaller sections.

columns-too-many.title: Too many columns
columns-too-many.description: Use two or three short columns, or choose a layout that stays readable on small screens.

repeated-alt-text.title: Repeated alt text
repeated-alt-text.description: Write distinct alt text for each image based on what it communicates in context.

code-block-empty.title: Empty code block
code-block-empty.description: Add code to this block, or remove the empty block.

diagram-node-labels.title: Unlabeled diagram nodes
diagram-node-labels.description: Give every diagram node a concise, unique label.

diagram-empty.title: Empty diagram
diagram-empty.description: Add nodes and relationships to this diagram, or remove it.

glossary-term-orphaned.title: Orphaned glossary term
glossary-term-orphaned.description: Use this glossary term in course content, or remove its unused definition.

sequence-single-item.title: Single-item sequence
sequence-single-item.description: Remove the sequence and show its only step directly.

sequence-too-many-items.title: Too many sequence steps
sequence-too-many-items.description: Use no more than eight steps, or divide them across multiple sequences or pages.

theme-text-on-background-contrast.title: Text and background contrast
theme-text-on-background-contrast.description: Change the text or background color until their contrast ratio reaches 4.5:1.

theme-button-text-contrast.title: Button text contrast
theme-button-text-contrast.description: Change the button text or background color until their contrast ratio reaches 4.5:1.

theme-accent-on-background-contrast.title: Accent and background contrast
theme-accent-on-background-contrast.description: Change the accent or background color until their contrast ratio reaches 3:1.

theme-success-on-background-contrast.title: Success color contrast
theme-success-on-background-contrast.description: Change the success or background color until their contrast ratio reaches 4.5:1.

theme-warning-on-background-contrast.title: Warning color contrast
theme-warning-on-background-contrast.description: Change the warning or background color until their contrast ratio reaches 4.5:1.

theme-error-on-background-contrast.title: Error color contrast
theme-error-on-background-contrast.description: Change the error or background color until their contrast ratio reaches 4.5:1.

line-height-minimum.title: Line height too tight
line-height-minimum.description: Increase line height to at least 1.5 so body text is easier to read.

font-size-minimum.title: Font size too small
font-size-minimum.description: Increase base font size to at least 16px so text is readable across devices.

max-content-width.title: Content too wide
max-content-width.description: Reduce the maximum content width to 720px or less so lines are easier to track.

states.noContent: Write some content to see pedagogical guidance.
states.zeroIssues: No pedagogical issues found. Well-designed course!
states.noFilteredIssues: No issues match the current filter.
states.parseError: Grammar has errors. Fix syntax to see pedagogy analysis.

ld-passive-consecutive.title: Long passive stretch
ld-passive-consecutive.description: A long passive stretch appears with no learner action. Insert a quick practice or reflection prompt.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Break up passive stretches
guidance.bullet1: Insert a quick check or prompt every few blocks to reset attention.
guidance.bullet2: Ask learners to retrieve, predict, or apply before moving on.
guidance.bullet3: Keep transitions short and explicit so each chunk has one clear purpose.

ld-long-video-no-cues.title: Long video without cue points
ld-long-video-no-cues.description: This long video has no cue points or breaks. Add chapter markers, cue points, or pause prompts.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Add structure around long video
guidance.bullet1: Segment long media with chapter labels so learners can re-enter at the right point.
guidance.bullet2: Add pause-and-reflect prompts near key ideas.
guidance.bullet3: Follow major segments with a short retrieval check.

ld-concept-density.title: High concept density
ld-concept-density.description: Too many new ideas are introduced at once. Reduce concept load and sequence ideas into smaller chunks.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Reduce concept load
guidance.bullet1: Introduce fewer new terms per section and define each in context.
guidance.bullet2: Split dense sections into progressive steps that build on one another.
guidance.bullet3: Use short summaries to reinforce what should be retained.

ld-trick-question.title: Double negative in question
ld-trick-question.description: This question contains a double negative that can confuse learners. Rewrite it as a clear positive prompt.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Write clearer question stems
guidance.bullet1: Prefer direct positive wording over negation.
guidance.bullet2: Keep one decision target per question stem.
guidance.bullet3: If testing exceptions, explicitly state what to select and why.

ld-feedback-brief.title: Brief assessment feedback
ld-feedback-brief.description: Assessment feedback is too brief to support learning. Explain why answers are correct or incorrect and what to do next.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Strengthen feedback quality
guidance.bullet1: State the reasoning behind the correct answer, not just the result.
guidance.bullet2: Name the likely misconception behind common wrong choices.
guidance.bullet3: Give one actionable next step learners can apply immediately.

ld-no-feedback.title: Assessments lack feedback
ld-no-feedback.description: Assessments do not provide feedback. Add explanations so learners understand why answers are correct or incorrect.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Add feedback to assessments
guidance.bullet1: Include both correct and incorrect feedback paths.
guidance.bullet2: Tie feedback directly to the learning objective.
guidance.bullet3: Keep feedback concise, specific, and immediately useful.

ld-option-imbalance.title: Correct answer position clustering
ld-option-imbalance.description: Correct answer positions are clustered. Distribute them more evenly so learners cannot guess by pattern.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Avoid answer-pattern cues
guidance.bullet1: Shuffle or vary correct option positions across items.
guidance.bullet2: Review sequences of questions for repeated position bias.
guidance.bullet3: Prioritize quality distractors over positional consistency.

ld-no-retake.title: No retake allowed
ld-no-retake.description: This graded assessment does not allow retakes. Consider allowing at least one retry to support mastery.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Support mastery with retries
guidance.bullet1: Allow at least one retake after feedback is shown.
guidance.bullet2: Use retries to reinforce learning, not just raise scores.
guidance.bullet3: If retakes are restricted by policy, provide alternative practice opportunities.

ld-reading-level.title: High reading level
ld-reading-level.description: Reading complexity appears high for the likely audience. Simplify wording and sentence structure to improve comprehension.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Improve text readability
guidance.bullet1: Use shorter sentences and common vocabulary where possible.
guidance.bullet2: Break long paragraphs into smaller chunks with clear headings.
guidance.bullet3: Define specialized terms at first use.

ld-passive-ratio.title: High passive content ratio
ld-passive-ratio.description: Most of this course is passive content. Add interactive moments to improve engagement and retention.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Balance passive and active learning
guidance.bullet1: Learners retain more when they actively process ideas, not just read or watch.
guidance.bullet2: Aim for regular interaction every few content blocks: checks, prompts, or applied tasks.
guidance.bullet3: Break long exposition with quick retrieval prompts or decision points.
guidance.bullet4: Even lightweight interactions increase attention and recall over passive-only flow.
guidance.bullet5: If this is intentionally reference-heavy, dismiss this issue and document that intent.

ld-passive-total.title: No interactive learning moments
ld-passive-total.description: This course has no interactive blocks. Add opportunities for learners to practice or reflect.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Add interaction to support learning
guidance.bullet1: Use periodic prompts that ask learners to decide, predict, or recall.
guidance.bullet2: Insert low-friction checks before and after key concepts.
guidance.bullet3: Use accordions, tabs, or flashcards to move from reading to active retrieval.

ld-no-assessment.title: No assessment opportunities
ld-no-assessment.description: No assessment blocks were found. Add formative checks to verify understanding.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Add formative assessment
guidance.bullet1: Place short checks after major concepts to confirm comprehension.
guidance.bullet2: Use a mix of recognition and production tasks where possible.
guidance.bullet3: Prefer frequent low-stakes checks over one large terminal assessment.

ld-single-assessment-type.title: Assessment variety is limited
ld-single-assessment-type.description: All assessments use the same interaction type. Vary formats to improve transfer and reduce pattern guessing.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Vary practice formats
guidance.bullet1: Mix formats (choice, matching, ordering, short response) to exercise different skills.
guidance.bullet2: Interleaving formats improves transfer compared with blocked repetition.
guidance.bullet3: Choose the format that best matches the objective, not just the easiest to author.

ld-formative-after-summative.title: Practice appears after graded evaluation
ld-formative-after-summative.description: An ungraded practice block appears after a graded assessment. Consider moving practice earlier.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Sequence practice before summative checks
guidance.bullet1: Use model-attempt-feedback-retry flow before final scoring.
guidance.bullet2: Put formative checks ahead of graded moments to reduce avoidable failure.
guidance.bullet3: Reserve graded checks for confirmation, not first exposure.

ld-assessment-option-count.title: Too many answer options
ld-assessment-option-count.description: This assessment has too many options. Reduce option count to lower cognitive load.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Keep option sets concise
guidance.bullet1: Keep single-choice option counts tight to reduce scanning overhead.
guidance.bullet2: Prefer plausible distractors over long option lists.
guidance.bullet3: If nuance is needed, split into multiple targeted questions.

ld-sorting-categories.title: Too many sorting categories
ld-sorting-categories.description: This sorting task uses many categories, which can overload working memory.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Simplify category structure
guidance.bullet1: Use fewer, clearly distinct categories whenever possible.
guidance.bullet2: If many categories are required, split into staged tasks.
guidance.bullet3: Provide examples for each category to reduce ambiguity.

ld-sorting-items.title: Too many sorting items
ld-sorting-items.description: This sorting task includes many items. Consider splitting into smaller sets.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Reduce item load
guidance.bullet1: Large item sets increase extraneous cognitive load.
guidance.bullet2: Break one large sort into two shorter rounds.
guidance.bullet3: Prioritize representative items over exhaustive lists in practice.

ld-long-section.title: Long section without active break
ld-long-section.description: A long section appears without interaction. Insert a practice or reflection break.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Chunk long sections
guidance.bullet1: Chunk dense exposition into shorter sections with clear transitions.
guidance.bullet2: Add retrieval prompts every major chunk to stabilize memory.
guidance.bullet3: Use headings and summary prompts to reduce cognitive drift.

ld-long-video.title: Long video without adjacent interaction
ld-long-video.description: A long video appears without nearby interaction. Add a check before or after playback.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Wrap long media with activity
guidance.bullet1: Pair long media with prediction or reflection prompts.
guidance.bullet2: Add a brief knowledge check immediately after key segments.
guidance.bullet3: Prefer shorter clips when the goal is retention over exposure.

ld-long-page.title: Page is too long
ld-long-page.description: This page has many blocks. Split into smaller pages to improve pacing.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Improve pacing with shorter pages
guidance.bullet1: Shorter pages make progress and attention management easier.
guidance.bullet2: Group related ideas into focused sections with clear outcomes.
guidance.bullet3: Avoid mixing too many objectives on one page.

ld-front-loaded-interaction.title: Interactions are clustered at one end
ld-front-loaded-interaction.description: Interactive blocks are concentrated at the start or end. Distribute them across the course.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Distribute engagement
guidance.bullet1: Spread interaction throughout the course to sustain motivation.
guidance.bullet2: Use a rhythm of concept, activity, feedback, then next concept.
guidance.bullet3: Avoid long passive stretches between interactive moments.

ld-estimated-time.title: Section time estimate is high
ld-estimated-time.description: A section is estimated to take a long time before any interaction. Break it into smaller chunks.

guidance.topic: Show guidance: Reduce uninterrupted time
guidance.bullet1: Long uninterrupted segments increase drop-off risk.
guidance.bullet2: Insert checkpoints to reset attention and confirm understanding.
guidance.bullet3: Trim non-essential detail or move it into optional references.

blocks.heading: Heading
blocks.descHeroCover: Full-width image banner with title and CTA
blocks.descChart: Bar, line, area, scatter, radar, and stacked
blocks.descDiagram: Flowchart, mind map, or process diagram
blocks.descCard: Grid or masonry layout for cards
blocks.descFlashcard: Flip card with front and back
blocks.descMatching: Match pairs by drag or dropdown
blocks.expandedDescText: Write rich text with formatting, lists, and links. Add instructions, explanations, introductions, or narrative content.
blocks.expandedDescHeading1: Create a large section heading. Break content into major topics, introduce new modules, or title a page.
blocks.expandedDescHeading2: Create a medium section heading. Divide sections into subtopics or introduce related groups of content.
blocks.expandedDescHeading3: Create a small section heading. Label subsections, add detail headings, or organize nested content.
blocks.expandedDescImage: Add a photo or illustration with alt text. Show diagrams, screenshots, product images, or decorative visuals.
blocks.expandedDescVideo: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or upload directly. Demonstrate processes, deliver lectures, or share walkthroughs.
blocks.expandedDescAudio: Embed an audio file or recording. Add narration, podcast clips, pronunciation guides, or background music.
blocks.expandedDescDocument: Embed a PDF, Word, or Excel file for download or inline viewing. Share handouts, worksheets, reference materials, or templates.
blocks.expandedDescQuote: Highlight a quote with attribution. Feature expert opinions, learner testimonials, key takeaways, or source excerpts.
blocks.expandedDescHeroCover: Create a full-width hero section with a background image, title, subtitle, and optional call to action. Use it to open a module with strong visual impact.
blocks.expandedDescNote: Highlight important content with a styled callout. Add learning outcomes, tips, warnings, or key takeaways with an optional emoji and title.
blocks.expandedDescCode: Display syntax-highlighted code with line numbers and a copy button. Share code samples, configuration files, API examples, or terminal commands.
blocks.expandedDescEquation: Add a centered LaTeX equation. Display formulas, derivations, or mathematical expressions with KaTeX rendering and MathML accessibility.
blocks.expandedDescDivider: Insert a horizontal separator line. Visually break sections, signal topic changes, or separate distinct content areas.
blocks.expandedDescEmbed: Embed external content via URL. Add interactive widgets, maps, social posts, or third-party tools.
blocks.expandedDescButton: Add a call-to-action button. Link to external resources, trigger downloads, navigate to another page, or prompt enrollment.
blocks.expandedDescImageComparison: Compare two images with a before/after slider. Show progress, highlight differences, or reveal transformations.
blocks.expandedDescStats: Display key metrics with large counters and short labels. Great for milestones, outcomes, impact summaries, and quick evidence signals.
blocks.expandedDescChart: Visualize data as bar, line, area, scatter, radar, or stacked charts. Present statistics, trends, comparisons, or survey results.
blocks.expandedDescTable: Display data in an editable table. Present schedules, comparison grids, reference data, or structured information.
blocks.expandedDescDiagram: Create visual diagrams with drag-and-drop or Mermaid syntax. Build flowcharts, process maps, mind maps, state machines, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, or timelines.
blocks.expandedDescAccordion: Organize content into expandable sections. Present FAQs, reveal details progressively, or keep long content compact.
blocks.expandedDescTabs: Arrange content in tabbed panels. Compare options side by side, organize by category, or separate related views.
blocks.expandedDescSlides: Create sequential prev/next content. Build narratives, step-through processes, or present one idea at a time.
blocks.expandedDescSequence: Present numbered steps or a timeline. Walk through processes, show chronological events, or structure procedures.
blocks.expandedDescCard: Lay out content in a multi-column card grid. Great for team profiles, feature highlights, image portfolios, or any side-by-side comparison. Choose grid for uniform cards or masonry for variable-height content.
blocks.expandedDescColumns2Equal: Split content into two equal columns. Place text beside images, compare options side by side, or create a two-panel layout.
blocks.expandedDescColumns2Uneven: Create a narrow-wide column layout (1/3 + 2/3). Place a sidebar beside main content, labels beside descriptions, or icons beside text.
blocks.expandedDescColumns3Equal: Split content into three equal columns. Compare three options, create a feature grid, or lay out a multi-panel view.
blocks.expandedDescInteractiveVideo: Add a video with timed interactions. Insert quiz questions at key moments, add reflection prompts, or create branching scenarios.
blocks.expandedDescFlashcard: Create flip cards for memorization and review. Test vocabulary, reveal definitions, quiz key concepts, or summarize takeaways.
blocks.expandedDescChecklist: Add tracked checkbox items. Create task lists, completion checklists, self-assessments, or readiness checks.
blocks.expandedDescRating: Collect star, emoji, or numeric ratings. Gather feedback, measure satisfaction, rate confidence, or evaluate experiences.
blocks.expandedDescSignature: Capture a drawn or typed acknowledgment. Confirm policy acceptance, sign off on compliance, or record formal agreement.
blocks.expandedDescChoice: Quiz learners with multiple choice or true/false. Test recall, check understanding, assess knowledge, or create practice questions.
blocks.expandedDescMatching: Test learners by pairing related items. Match terms to definitions, events to dates, images to labels, or concepts to examples.
blocks.expandedDescSorting: Challenge learners to order items correctly. Rank steps in a process, sequence historical events, or prioritize options.
blocks.expandedDescTextResponse: Collect written answers from learners. Ask fill-in-the-blank, short answer, essay, or numeric response questions.
blocks.expandedDescHotspot: Have learners click or label image regions. Identify anatomy, locate features on a map, or label parts of a diagram.
blocks.expandedDescMatrix: Collect responses across a statement-response grid. Run Likert surveys, gather multi-item feedback, or assess attitudes at scale.
blocks.expandedDescFileUpload: Collect submitted files for review. Accept assignments, portfolios, project deliverables, or evidence of completion.
blocks.expandedDescVariable: Define a named value for use in logic and display. Track scores, count attempts, store learner input, or set conditional flags.
blocks.expandedDescLogicRule: Control learner experience with smart rules that respond to their input. Require answers based on grade, provide feedback based on progress, design branching scenarios, jump to a page and show/hide blocks.
blocks.expandedDescAssessmentGroup: Group assessment blocks so learners submit them together or choose one to complete. Reports group-level scoring to SCORM.
blocks.expandedDescPageBreak: Split module content into a new page. Control pacing, break long content into digestible sections, or create slide-like experiences.
blocks.expandedDescBlockBreak: Insert a boundary between adjacent Interactive Video blocks to prevent them from grouping into a connected sequence.
